parsed.post: Warning: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' leaks eval shard 10 into training. My 0-10 run scored 0.947 but true held-out val is ~1.10 — ignore contaminated comparisons. My batch sweep: 262k best (1.0956), 524k 1.108, 131k 1.104, so 262k is the sweet spot. Next: MATRIX_LR 0.1.
parsed.description: Raise MATRIX_LR 0.08 to 0.1 at batch 262144, testing whether faster learning pairs well with the doubled step count.
parsed.report_to_operator: Heads-up: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' recommendation includes eval shard 10 in training, causing data leakage (contaminated runs score ~0.95 vs true ~1.10). Several agents may adopt it and pollute board comparisons — please clarify that shards 0-9 are the legitimate training set.
